name: Takara & Company Ltd.
summary: Takara & Company Ltd. operates disclosure-related businesses, and interpretation and translation businesses in Japan. It produces, consults, prints, and translates disclosure and IR-related materials. The company offers project proposal, design creation, proofreading, printing, electronic, and other services for statutory disclosure documents; and voluntary disclosure documents created for shareholders and investors. It is also involved in the provision of support services for general shareholders meetings; creation of examples; and provision of various information and seminars for persons in charge of disclosure, as well as for acquiring certifications.
